integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled checker only verifies algebraic identities and numerical consistency and is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives an explicit counterexample at \(p=4\) only; it does not classify all \(p>2\) or all extremal norms.
title: A uniformly non-square counterexample to the \(p\)-isosceles conjecture at \(p=4\)
